title: Mara and the Ghost
premise: Oscar Yarrow, a deniable fixer for the Meridian Trust — an embassy that exists on no map — receives a call on a burner phone from Mara Voss, the analyst he loved and buried two years ago. She is alive, hiding inside a conspiracy that spans three governments: a sanctioned assassination program disguised as counterterrorism, and she has the ledger that proves it. As Oscar smuggles her across borders while dodging the Trust's own enforcer, an assassin called Ghost who once trained him, he must choose between the institution that owns him and the woman he mourned. The truth gets out only when Oscar burns his own legend to do it; Ghost, moved by a loyalty older than his orders, lets them live and disappears. In the end, Mara testifies from the shadows while Oscar, officially dead at last, walks free in a city where no one knows his name.
about_author: Beatrix Dunmore is the pen name of a former diplomatic correspondent who spent a decade filing dispatches from capitals that preferred not to be named. She writes thrillers about the gap between what governments admit and what they do.

chapters.title: The Go-Bag
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. A routine night in Vienna: burning documents, checking passports, rehearsing lies for the Meridian Trust. We learn his rules — never love, never stay, never look back. Emotional beat: controlled loneliness, the polish over dread.

chapters.title: A Voice from the Dead
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. A burner phone left in his coat pocket rings; Mara Voss speaks — the analyst whose funeral he attended. She gives him ninety seconds of proof, then coordinates. Emotional beat: vertigo, grief cracking open into hope.

chapters.title: What the Ledger Says
chapters.summary: Mara's POV, flashback-threaded. Two years hiding in Tallinn, assembling evidence of the Sable Program: assassinations laundered through three governments' joint counterterror framework. Emotional beat: righteous fear hardening into resolve.

chapters.title: The Man Who Trains Ghosts
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. He reports the call to his handler, half-testing, half-lying — and realizes the Trust already knows. They assign him to find 'the leak,' partnered with an operative called Ghost, whom Oscar trained. Emotional beat: cold recognition that he is now prey wearing a hunter's badge.

chapters.title: Ninety Seconds in Prague
chapters.summary: Dual POV. Oscar meets Mara in a railway station crowd; Ghost watches from the mezzanine, ordered to observe. Their reunion is all tradecraft and trembling hands. Emotional beat: love against duty, first collision.

chapters.title: Rules of Disappearance
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. On the run through Bohemia, she teaches Oscar her survival system — dead drops, pattern breaks — while he hides how much the Trust suspects. Emotional beat: intimacy rebuilt on mutual deception.

chapters.title: Three Governments, One Lie
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. A Trust briefing reveals each government believes the other two authorized Sable; the ledger would indict them all. His handler orders Mara's death framed as terrorism. Emotional beat: disillusionment curdling into defiance.

chapters.title: Ghost's Orders
chapters.summary: Ghost's POV, first time. We see the assassin's discipline, his private ledger of names, and the moment he identifies Oscar in surveillance footage — and says nothing. Emotional beat: loyalty beginning to war with obedience.

chapters.title: The Safehouse That Wasn't
chapters.summary: Dual POV. A supposed refuge in Ljubljana is a trap; Oscar springs it, and they escape through flooded cellars as Ghost arrives minutes late, deliberately slow. Emotional beat: terror sharpening into trust neither will name.

chapters.title: Confession at 3 A.M.
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Cornered in a barn, she and Oscar finally speak plainly: why she faked her death, why he never searched harder. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into commitment — love chosen knowingly this time.

chapters.title: The Handler's Gambit
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. His handler offers absolution: deliver Mara, retire clean. Oscar accepts aloud and begins planning betrayal before the elevator doors close. Emotional beat: the fixer fixing his own exit.

chapters.title: Border of Ash
chapters.summary: Dual POV. A checkpoint crossing goes wrong; Mara is taken, Oscar escapes wounded, and Ghost — present again — lets him go with one word: 'Ledger.' Emotional beat: despair, then the realization that Ghost wants the truth out too.

chapters.title: What Ghost Knows
chapters.summary: Ghost's POV. Backstory: Ghost's sister was a Sable casualty listed as an accident. He has been collecting proof for years, waiting for someone with Oscar's access. Emotional beat: the assassin revealed as the story's second mourner.

chapters.title: The Trade
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Oscar offers himself to the Trust in exchange for Mara's release — the ultimate fixer's transaction, trading his own legend as currency. Emotional beat: sacrifice disguised as negotiation.

chapters.title: Interrogation by Candlelight
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Held in a black site, Mara turns her interrogation around, seeding doubt in her captor with fragments of the ledger. Emotional beat: the analyst as weapon; courage under pressure.

chapters.title: Burning the Legend
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. With Ghost's quiet help, Oscar torches his identities, accounts, and the Trust's leverage over him — becoming officially nobody. Emotional beat: liberation through self-destruction.

chapters.title: The Extraction
chapters.summary: Dual POV. Ghost and Oscar hit the black site together, teacher and student fighting back-to-back. Mara walks out; Ghost takes a bullet meant for Oscar. Emotional beat: loyalty outweighing every order ever given.

chapters.title: Three Capitals, One Morning
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. The ledger reaches journalists in three countries within hours; resignations cascade, denials collapse. Emotional beat: justice outside the law, arriving like weather.

chapters.title: Ghost's Last Contract
chapters.summary: Ghost's POV. Wounded, Ghost faces the Trust's cleanup team alone at a Danube dock to buy time for the story to land. He wins ugly and vanishes into the fog. Emotional beat: a ghost finally at peace with being unseen.

chapters.title: Testimony from the Shadows
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. From an undisclosed location, Mara gives sealed testimony via the very burner network she built; the Sable Program is formally dismantled. Emotional beat: vindication without applause.

chapters.title: The City Where No One Knows His Name
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Lisbon, rain, a small apartment. Oscar, legally dead, learns to live unpolished — no go-bag, no lies. A postcard arrives with no signature, only a drawn ghost. Emotional beat: quiet grace after ruin.

chapters.title: Mara and the Ghost
chapters.summary: Mara's POV, closing. Months later, Mara finds Oscar; Ghost sends word he's watching over them both, one last loyalty kept. The phone that started everything rings once more — and this time, they answer together. Emotional beat: love and truth, finally on the same side.
